name: hyprweather
description: Atmospheric Linux weather app with an animated sky
author: ka-capek <kcapek46@gmail.com>

scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 64 128 256 512 1024; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s build/icon.svg -o build/icons/${s}x${s}.png; done
scripts.build:sky: npm --prefix WeatherAnimationLab ci --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix WeatherAnimationLab run build
